label: P1.30 Provider Adapter Audit

timeout.note: No explicit timeout set on openai.OpenAI client in DeepSeekClient.__init__. Relies on SDK default (600s). This is a gap for real provider safety.

retry_policy.note: No explicit retry policy. SDK default behavior applies.

rate_limit_handling.note: No rate limit handler in DeepSeekClient. AuthenticationError and APIError caught in chat(); no RateLimitError specific handling.

cost_accounting.note: DeepSeekClient.chat() does not capture usage.prompt_tokens or usage.completion_tokens from the response. Cost tracking requires adding usage capture to the client.

gaps_for_real_provider_activation: No timeout configured on OpenAI client (should be ≤30s for live arbitration)
No rate limit error handling (should trigger legacy_pi_failed fallback)
No token usage capture (required for cost accounting)
No budget guard interceptor in call path
adapter_audit_conclusion: Adapter is correctly wired through Analysis Agent → Review Agent → live arbitration pipeline. Safety fallbacks structurally present. However, 5 gaps must be closed before real provider can be safely activated.
note: Adapter audit complete. Architecture is safe; implementation gaps prevent real activation.
